title: Cross-domain assembly instrument: function entry
description: Status: co-authored (Kavik + Claude), 2026-11-03. CC0. One entry per FUNCTION (what is needed), never per material. Each branch is one candidate way to meet the function; each junction is one joining step and carries its own provenance. validate.py enforces this file's structure plus the rules in x-rules.

x-rules.chain_length: chain_length == len(junctions). Integer count of joining steps in the branch.
x-rules.verification_required: Rises with chain_length. 0-1 -> SINGLE_BUILD_CHECK; 2-3 -> TEST_EACH_JUNCTION; > 3 (above threshold) -> TEST_EACH_JUNCTION_THEN_FULL_TRIAL. Any irreversible junction raises the floor to TEST_EACH_JUNCTION. PROPOSED***: the levels are an ordering rule, not calibrated against build-failure data.
x-rules.compounding_error: Entry-level flag. true iff any branch has chain_length above verification_threshold OR two or more consecutive INFERRED_BY_ASSEMBLY junctions. Each untested join multiplies the chance the whole chain fails.
x-rules.irreversibility: Entry-level flag. true iff any junction in any branch has irreversible: true.
x-rules.reader_state: Entry-level flag. true iff every irreversible junction's hazard line passes the legibility check in validate.py (plain words, not jargon-only).
x-rules.provenance: TESTED = built and checked by the named source under the stamped conditions. DOCUMENTED = recorded in a named source, not built by this instrument. INFERRED_BY_ASSEMBLY = joined here by function; nobody has recorded this join working. A claim never moves up this ladder without a new source.
x-rules.thin_volume: Trailing asterisks on any claim string mark thin evidence; more asterisks = thinner.

function.description: What is needed, stated as a requirement, not as a material.

requirement_note.description: Optional: what the requirement is underneath the familiar answer.

results_return.description: How a build failure (or success) gets reported back into the entry.

value.description: String so ranges, '<<1' and NOT MEASURED stay honest.

hazard.description: Required, plain language, when irreversible is true. No method vocabulary.

caution.description: Plain-language field caution. validate.py --ledger requires it (R6) when the ledger puts this irreversible junction in CAUTION. Added by a person; status.py never writes it.
